title: Anthropic worker claims to have solved a Holy Grail of math problems with the help of AI
summary: Levent Alpoge, a member of the company's technical staff, made the announcement Friday by way of a four-page explanation posted on his website. He said that he believes by working with Claude, he has found a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis.
llm_summary: Levent Alpoge, a technical staff member at Anthropic, posted a four‑page write‑up claiming that, with the help of the company’s AI model Claude, he has produced a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis—a problem that’s been called the “Holy Grail” of mathematics.
